_comment: The Rolodex (rolodex.lol) - a community-run directory of improv/sketch shows and open jams, documented at https://rolodex.lol/developers. Public JSON, no key, 60 req/min/IP. Its listings are the long tail no ticketing API indexes: independent troupes in small rooms, most without a Ticketmaster/SeatGeek presence at all. The API returns a venue STRING and no coordinates, so each site supplies a venue book - street+city+region per room - which the sync geocodes (mapsee_supabase_sync._addr_parts needs a street, and drops anything it cannot place). Rows whose venue string already carries a full address are parsed inline and need no entry. Add a room here the first time the adapter logs it as unplaceable.
